_doc: Every print piece, in the order print.json lists them. src/lib/kit/print.js PRINT_PIECES mirrors file, name, size, pages and review (print.test.js compares them). Inches, trim size; 0.125 in bleed on every side. qr: the codes each page carries and their printed size without the quiet zone (at least 0.75 in). review pieces need a Google review link and are left out without one.

pieces.name: Review hang tag
pieces.stock: 14-16 pt card, both sides printed, die-cut

pieces.name: Counter card
pieces.stock: 16 pt card, front only; stands in an acrylic sign holder or on an easel back

pieces.name: Glovebox card
pieces.stock: 16 pt card, both sides printed (business-card size)
